newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$3.0 bln 4.0 pct bonds due 1999.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$3.0 bln 4.0 pct bonds due 1999.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on March 12 C$3.0 billion of bonds with a coupon of 4.0 percent and maturing on March 15, 1999.

The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on March 17, pay interest on September 15 and March 15, the government said. It said the new bonds are in addition to C$3.0 billion bonds due March 15, 1999 already outstanding.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to redeem C$4.8 billion of government bonds maturing March 15, 1997, of which the Bank of Canada holds C$25 million.
